notes: Compact ultra-low-temperature stirred-liquid metrology bath, -80 C to 100 C, cascade refrigeration with two 1/4 HP compressors and a 500 W heater; 1700 VA at 115 V/60 Hz or 230 V/50 Hz. Outer box 305 W x 762 H x 610 D mm, 52 kg, casters fitted. The 4 L stainless-steel tank sits under an insulated lid carrying the stirring motor (under a motor cover), the control PRT in a small hole, and the 83 x 114 mm rectangular access hole with an insulated access cover the user may drill for probe fixtures; max immersion 180 mm. Fluid level 12 to 50 mm below tank top. Back panel: circuit breaker, IEC power inlet, drain valve, RS-232 connector, removable vent panel. Stability +/-0.006 C and uniformity +/-0.008 C at -80 C (ethanol); cooling 25 C to -80 C in 130 min. Source discrepancies: the current Fluke product page gives Access Opening 86 x 114 mm, Depth 178 mm and 'Size (WxDxH) 305 x 610 x 762 mm' vs the User's Guide 83 x 114 mm / 180 mm (the catalog capabilities use 83 mm and 178 mm); the catalog description's 'two 1/2 HP compressors' is not supported by the manual, which says 'Two 1/4 HP compressors'.
